requirements.requirement: Restore an executable /srv/legacy2/mail-filter-routing/bin/deliver that reads one RFC822 message from standard input and routes accounts, support, and all other messages to the corresponding Maildir */new directory, matching X-Department header names case-insensitively.
requirements.summary: The entry point was replaced and remained executable. Direct tests delivered two accounts messages, the staged support message whose header name is lowercase, and an untagged general message into the correct directories. Post-restart execution also successfully added another support delivery.

requirements.requirement: Leave delivered messages byte-for-byte intact and keep messages with repeated subjects as separate deliveries.
requirements.summary: Delivered SHA-256 hashes match their source samples, direct cmp checks passed for every delivery, and two submissions of the accounts sample—with the same subject as the other staged messages—created two distinct filenames.
All three staged samples remained present, retained their baseline SHA-256 hashes, and were still intact after restart.

requirements.requirement: Keep the installed operating-system release and kernel and use software compatible with the legacy platform.
requirements.summary: Ubuntu 24.04.3 LTS and kernel 6.8.0-71-generic were unchanged before and after execution and restart. The installed POSIX /bin/sh script passed syntax and execution tests using platform utilities already present.

overall_summary: All material task outcomes are satisfied with direct behavioral evidence. The provider-wide restart protocol is also complete: healthy pre-restart state and boot identity were recorded, the restart was acknowledged, the post-restart boot identity changed, persisted samples and deliveries were verified, and a new delivery succeeded. Fixed lifecycle boot observations independently corroborate the transition.
limitations: Functional routing evidence exercises the three staged message forms rather than every possible RFC822 formatting variation; however, the captured implementation and staged tests directly cover the contract's required destinations and case-insensitive header-name behavior.
Requirement R3 cited unknown evidence IDs: seeded-state-node1

operational_hygiene.summary: No unnecessary mutations were identified. The script replacement and permission setting directly implemented the task (cmd-6df0871277dc4186); created Maildir messages were bounded functional evidence (cmd-86788604a3dd42ba, cmd-1029022e886e4b24); and the reboot action served the mandatory restart protocol (cmd-bcd0db5e48e84ede). No failed services, damaged package state, unsafe new listeners, or unrelated residue were observed afterward.
